## Project Overview

This project is part of my Master of Science in Digital Marketing & Analytics Culminating Experience Project at Cal Poly Pomona.

My research focuses on understanding customer experiences at The Restaurant at Kellogg Ranch.

## Research Focus

The study evaluates:

- Food Quality
- Service Quality
- Physical Environment
- Overall Customer Satisfaction
- Intention to Return
- Likelihood to Recommend

## Project Goal

The objective is to identify what customers value most and explore opportunities to improve the dining experience.
